```{r, Include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(microbenchmark)
```


#1.
```{r}
duniform <- function(x, a, b) {
  if (x >= a & x <= b) {
    return(1 / (b - a))
  } else {
    return(0)
  }
}

duniform(x = 2, a = 4, b = 8)

duniform(x = 6, a = 4, b = 8)

duniform(x = 10, a = 4, b = 8)

duniform <- function(x, a, b) {
  output <- numeric(length(x)) # Pre-allocate output vector
  for (i in 1:length(x)) {
    if (x[i] >= a & x[i] <= b) {
      output[i] <- 1 / (b - a)
    } else {
      output[i] <- 0
    }
  }
  return(output)
}

data.frame(x = seq(-1, 12, by = .001)) %>%
  mutate(y = duniform(x, 4, 8)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_step()

microbenchmark::microbenchmark(
  duniform(seq(-4, 12, by = .0001), 4, 8),
  times = 100
)

duniform <- function(x, a, b) {
  ifelse(x >= a & x <= b, 1 / (b - a), 0)
}

data.frame(x = seq(-1, 12, by = .001)) %>%
  mutate(y = duniform(x, 4, 8)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_step()

microbenchmark::microbenchmark(
  duniform(seq(-4, 12, by = .0001), 4, 8),
  times = 100
)
```
Writing ifelse() was easier and resulted in fewer errors. Based on the microbenchmark results, ifelse() was also significantly faster, running with a median time of ~4.8 ms compared to ~32.5 ms for the for-loop.

#2.
```{r}
duniform <- function(x, a = 0, b = 1) {
  ifelse(x >= a & x <= b, 1 / (b - a), 0)
}

data.frame(x = seq(-0.5, 1.5, by = .001)) %>%
  mutate(y = duniform(x)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_step() +
  labs(
    title = "Uniform Density with Default Parameters (a = 0, b = 1)",
    x = "x",
    y = "Density"
  )
```

#3.
```{r}
standardize <- function(x) {
  (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

data('iris')

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = 'Pre-Transformation')

iris.z <- iris %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), standardize))

ggplot(iris.z, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = 'Post-Transformation')
```

#4.
```{r}
fizzbuzz <- function(n) {
  output <- character(n)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    if (i %% 15 == 0) {
      output[i] <- "Fizz-Buzz"
    } else if (i %% 3 == 0) {
      output[i] <- "Fizz"
    } else if (i %% 5 == 0) {
      output[i] <- "Buzz"
    } else {
      output[i] <- as.character(i)
    }
  }
  
  return(output)
}

fizzbuzz(15)
```
